jobs.description: Payoneer is a leader in global online money transfer and digital payment services. I worked with the front-end engineering team developing checkout software and libraries that enabled businesses to receive payments online on their e-commerce sites. My work mainly involved coding, integration, unit/functional testing, QA, Deployment, Monitoring, and Incident management among others

Savannah Informatics is the leading health informatics company in Kenya. They facilitate patient data movement between hospitals and insurers during a hospital visit. I worked as a front-end engineer developing web applications to be used by insurance companies and hospital staff. The main Front-end web frameworks that we use are AngularJS and React. We also do a lot of unit testing to ensure the stability of the systems since our work serves a lot of people.

Mobilit Africa is a software company in Nairobi that specializes in web and mobile app development. I was part of the front-end development team. Most of my activities involved UI design and prototyping, features development using React, and the creation of unit tests

TKL is a business management software provider. I worked as a developer and a software consultant. I helped develop some of the features of a payroll application and offered consultation services on other business software applications. I mainly worked with angular js, javascript, HTML, and CSS.
